canonicalSummary: Sauvage by Dior is a September 2015 men's Eau de Toilette created by François Demachy. It is classified as an Aromatic Fougère. The top notes open with Calabrian Bergamot and Pepper; the heart includes Sichuan Pepper, Lavender, Pink Pepper, Vetiver, Patchouli, Geranium and Elemi; the base is anchored by Ambroxan, Cedar and Labdanum. Ambroxan is the signature material of the EdT, producing a radiant, clean, fresh-woody base. The Dior Sauvage family includes EdP (2018) and Parfum (2019) concentrations which are distinct compositions; this dossier concerns the EdT (2015) only. All findings concern the reference fragrance and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
